## About
VIP Tire & Automotive is a family-owned shop on S La Brea Ave in Los Angeles, run by Mark Husereau. We handle new tires and custom wheels, complete brakes, oil changes, flat tire repair, smogs, air conditioning, electrical, fuel injection and front end work.
One reviewer wrote that Mark took the time to understand the issues and laid out all the options before any work began. Whether your engine light just came on or you need a new set of tires, stop by or give us a call Monday through Friday.

## Services
- Tires and custom wheels: New tires, wheels and flat tire repair for your car.
- Brakes: Complete brake work, including brakes and rotors.
- Diagnostics and repairs: Engine light on? We run through the diagnosis and go over your repair options with you.
- Smogs and tire repairs: Routine smogs and tire repairs to keep your car on the road.

## FAQ
Q: What days are you open?
A: We are open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We are at 1301 S. La Brea Ave., Unit B, in Los Angeles.

What really set Mark and Victor apart was their exceptional service. They made me feel comfortable throughout the entire process, ensuring that I understood each step before moving forward. It’s this level of detail and customer focus that makes their service truly exceptional.

In an industry that often feels transactional at best, Mark and Victor provide a masterclass in what auto service should be—thoughtful, comprehensive, and genuinely caring. I can’t recommend them highly enough; they’ve gained a lifetime customer in me." (Jacob Mendoza, 5/5)
